title: Autumn Woods
description: Inspired by pointillist art and an autumnal walk. I love seeing pheasants at this time of the year!

title: Fetcham Park House
description: A local heritage building now used as a business and events centre.

title: Bridge of Spies
description: Inspired by a visit to Berlin and Potsdam in Germany. I was fascinated by the wartime story associated with this bridge.

title: Opera House
description: A famous Australian landmark shown in the native Aboriginal style.

title: Birds
description: Inspired by the yin yang style of Hilda Klimt and a photo of a bird silhouette taken on a visit to RSPB Pulborough.

title: Brandenberg Gate
description: Another global landmark captured in my own style after my visit to Berlin.

title: Churchyard
description: I initially based this on a church I visited in Saxmundham in Suffolk, but this is a typical English church scene and also reminds me of a local Guildford church - St Marthas.

title: Malta
description: Inspired by a family holiday in Malta - a country with many churches, historic buildings and unique fishing villages with distinctive boats.

title: Sea Creatures
description: A fun abstract-style piece

title: Rowing on the Cam
description: For my brother, who captained his rowing team at Trinity College, Cambridge.

title: Avebury
description: Inspired by my visit to the standing stone circle in Avebury, Wiltshire.

title: Hadrian's Wall
description: Another family holiday destination, I was impressed by the scale of this Roman Wall in this vast, and often deserted landscape.

title: Stonehenge
description: This ancient site is one I drive past on visits to family in Devon. This was my first painting in what has now become my signature style.

title: Phonehenge
description: Inspired by a discussion on Surrealism, I reinterpreted my Stonehenge piece for the modern era. What does society worship today?

title: Cathedral
description: Based on a visit to Cologne cathedral although reimagined in a more impressionistic way

title: Paris Cafe
description: After my visit to Paris in 2023 my key memory was of the cafes and I used a pointillist style and silhouettes to show the night scene.

title: Teddy
description: My beloved childhood bear ready for a summer picnic

title: Sunflower
description: Sunflowers will always be cheerful!

title: Guildford High Street
description: My home town with the iconic clock and cobbled street formed from around 60,000 granite "setts". I have shown this in a way that highlights its historical character. To enquire, please follow the link in the contact page

title: Lake Bled, Slovenia
description: A beautiful holiday destination where I took countless photos. This depicts the distinctive island where I rang the Church bell three times in the hope that, according to legend, my wishes would be granted. To enquire, please follow the link in the contact page

title: Wave
description: One of my earliest pieces which I painted when experimenting with reinterpreting the work of Japanese masters.

title: Silk Roads
description: Inspired by a visit to an exhibition at the British Museum in London. I wanted to encapsulate the elements of the Silk Road trading - the routes, the items, the lovely colours, the ancient symbols and methods of transport.

title: Treat Time Tortoise
description: Created for a cafe project at Artventure. I do not drink coffee! So I focussed on food and a fun way of presenting it.

title: Wild flowers
description: Painted during Covid, this reminds me of our daily walks through local fields in the summer of 2020.

file: Ink and Watercolours/Amy Swan painting v2
title: Swan on the River Wey
description: I took some photos on an outing to Wisley Gardens and loved the image of the swan and its reflection.

title: Bear Hugs
description: My first experiment with a pop art style. I love teddy bears, bright colours and "Bear Hugs" makes me smile.

title: Paignton Pier
description: Capturing the British seaside in the summer and reminding me of my visits to family in Devon.

title: Microbes
description: Artventure were working on a theme of "All creatures great and small" so I chose to represent the smallest living organisms in a colourful way.
